1.headline: From gym nerves to renewed confidence
1.excerpt: His words his caring support meant so much to me.
1.summary: Amarjit describes feeling more confident, changing her everyday eating habits and going from a size 16 to a size 12.

journey.label: Starting point
journey.text: New to the gym and unsure of herself, Amarjit wanted to make a change to her health.

journey.label: Personal support
journey.text: Jaz helped her feel at ease, with encouragement and consistent support as she trained.

journey.label: Progress
journey.text: She reports renewed confidence, different eating habits and a change from size 16 to size 12.

2.headline: A plan that worked around being a working mum
2.excerpt: We kept her favourite foods in the nutrition plan, she completed a minimum of 2 resistance training workouts a week and hit her weekly steps target.
2.summary: Online coaching, regular check-ins and realistic training helped Gopi work towards her weight-loss and health goals.

3.headline: Finding motivation as a couple
3.excerpt: He made each session fun and challenging
3.summary: Shared sessions brought encouragement, friendly competition and a growing sense of progress in their health and fitness.

4.headline: More confidence, with structure that lasted
4.excerpt: I have since become disciplined, learnt to make healthier food choices without feeling deprived, and know the importance of consistency.
4.summary: Aamir describes a tailored training and nutrition plan that helped him become more active and confident in his food choices.

5.headline: Learning to train with purpose
5.excerpt: I’ve felt a lot more confident about my form and technique
5.summary: Natasha went from feeling unsure about exercises to following a structured routine and understanding how to track her progress.

22.headline: Building confidence to train again
22.excerpt: The key message throughout from Jaz was patience and consistency.
22.summary: After years away from weights, Pam describes a gradual, personalised approach to rebuilding strength and confidence.
